recording: a7z:~/duck-logs/calls_200910.wav (48 kHz, 4 ch S32, 714 s, 20:09:10-20:21:04 EDT; copy in the MacBook session scratchpad, to go to recordings/ with the next offload)
shawn_words: 我刚才录了8个方向的声音 鸭子在地上 我也站地上 我186cm高 让鸭子每45度顺时针转了一圈
setup: Shawn stood still on the floor (186 cm) about 2 m from the duck (straight line; elevation about 37 deg), the duck stood on the floor with namecall stopped (record_calls.sh); the first call was face on, then the duck was turned 45 deg clockwise (seen from above) between calls, one call per direction about 10 s apart. Bearing in the duck's frame (positive = left, as MICS_MM): 0, +45, +90, +135, 180, -135, -90, -45. No call before 20:17:59; the first 8.7 min are talk and movement.
purpose: held-out test set for the name spotter (never training) and the first labelled directions for the head's own lag/level table (fit from bearing_seen stays separate)

before_the_calls_0_to_520_s.what: about 8.7 min of Shawn moving about and talking before the first call (20:09:10-20:17:50); Shawn confirmed he did not call in there: a certified negative stretch (v2: 0 peaks >= 0.3)

spotter_findings.e3_is_a_voice_detector: E3 scores 0.95 on a confirmed-call slice played backwards (c04 reversed; raw 0.98), and 0.79-0.94 on each single microphone: it keys on Shawn's voice spectrum, not on the word. That is the mechanism behind 'I call and it does not answer, I talk and it answers'.
spotter_findings.v2_is_a_word_model: v2 (openWakeWord round 2) on the eight certain calls: ear mix 7/8 (the +135 call 0.01 on the mix but 0.87 on the right ear; max over the two ears 8/8), 0 peaks >= 0.3 in the 8.7 min before the calls, 0 false on all held-out sets. The '8/14' figure came from E3-made spans of 0.2-0.4 s (fragments, not words): five of the six misses are those fragments; gain made no difference (+0..+18 dB).
spotter_findings.confirmed_15_calls_doubt: the 15 'camera-confirmed' calls of 18:53-19:47 were triggered by E3 and confirmed only by a face in view afterwards; v2 and the official openwakeword runtime score 0.00 on all 15, so they are not verified calls and cannot serve as a test set until listened to.

direction_findings.live_localiser: side right on 5 of 7 side calls, magnitude wrong (as every night)
direction_findings.whole_word_lags_1500_6000: all within +-27 us (one 48 kHz sample) in every direction: at 2 m with about 8 dB over the room in this band the cross-correlation carries no direction
direction_findings.ild_note: the 2.5-4 kHz left-right level difference gives the side on 6 of 6 side calls (and about +1 to +3 dB in front and behind, a right-ear offset to calibrate out); one call per direction, so no leave-one-out yet; a second round with three calls per direction validates the table
direction_findings.onset_first_wavefront: no clean onset found on 7 of 8 calls at this level (the 'Mo' starts softly); precedence-window lags are not usable at 2 m

shawn_words_confirming: 对 第一声是鸭子正对我 然后从上往下看顺时针转 我站的地方离鸭子站的地方大约直线距离2米远 之前没有叫过 (20:26)
